answer: Forging 260 of these means building 260 separate licence histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The defence rests on software licence tenure with activation history: a licence activated and renewed on one machine for years. The garden check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The zephyr record is public, the anchor cost is per identity, and 260 aliases cost 260 times one honest seat.
